start.description: start date for the data point

outlierCode.description:
outlierCode: 0 or no value -- regular point
             1 -- to be ignored when returning results of value outlier analysis
             2 -- is an estimated value
             3 -- combination of 1 and 2 together

enum (0, 1, 2)

comments.description: (Optional) any comments for the data point

isEstimated.description: Denotes if the value is an actual value or an estimated value. default = null (actual value)

dataVersion.description:
Same data points can have different data version to denote priority. Default behavior in case of overlapping
data points is to pick the data point with the highest data version.
If data version is not specified, then default (avg) overlap handling is applied to the overalapping data points

statusCode.description: Customer specific status code for the data point (may be used to denote data quality)

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

value.description:
The predicted risk score value derived from a machine learning model or reliability model.
It represents the forecasted risk score, which could be used for asset health assessments, failure probabilities,
or other risk-related metrics within reliability models.

`@ts(treatmentPath="parent.treatment", unitPath="parent.unitConstraint")` - Specifies the path to retrieve the
treatment value and unit constraints from the parent entity. This ensures that the value is appropriately treated
and conforms to the expected units.

valueUpperBound.description:
The upper bound for the predicted risk score value.
This field defines the maximum allowable value for the risk score prediction. It serves as a threshold to ensure that
the predicted value doesn't exceed a reasonable or acceptable limit. For example, it could ensure that predictions
don't surpass 100% risk or any other pre-defined upper limit based on business logic or safety concerns.

valueLowerBound.description:
The lower bound for the predicted risk score value.
This field defines the minimum allowable value for the risk score prediction. It ensures that the risk score does not
drop below a predefined minimum threshold, which might be useful to avoid implausibly low predictions or to guarantee
that the model does not produce invalid or extreme negative predictions.

title:
Represents a prediction related to the risk score in the context of machine learning or reliability modeling.
This entity captures predicted values, along with their upper and lower bounds, for assessing potential risks.
The entity mixes the properties of `TimedDataPoint` and includes metadata from `ReliabilityRiskScoreMlPredictionHeader` for additional context.
For details on other information stored in this Type, refer to the documentation on each of the fields of this Type.
name: ReliabilityRiskScoreMlPrediction
